mapper.sql: SELECT r.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atomic_requirement a WHERE a.requirement_id = r.id) AS atomic_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_case tc JOIN atomic_requirement a ON a.id = tc.atomic_requirement_id WHERE a.requirement_id = r.id) AS test_case_count FROM requirement r
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_case tc WHERE tc.atomic_requirement_id = a.id) AS test_case_count FROM atomic_requirement a WHERE a.requirement_id = #{requirementId} ORDER BY a.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO requirement (project_id, req_code, title, description, source, priority) VALUES (#{projectId}, (SELECT CONCAT('REQ-', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(req_code, 5) AS INT)), 0) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0')) FROM requirement WHERE project_id = #{projectId}), #{title}, #{description}, #{source}, #{priority})
